item.description:
### Fixed - **Existing setups survive the move from the preview app to OpenSwitch.** Settings, monitor data, and the acknowledged shared-computer setup are copied forward without replacing newer files. - **Setup instructions now appear in the setup wizard**, rather than taking space in Computers settings. - **A failed setup save explains that the other Mac may need OpenSwitch opened or updated.**
### Release candidate - This is an in-app update for RC2. Macs still running a preview-bundle build need one manual install.
### Added - **Support for three or more Macs in one shared setup.** Pair each Mac directly, then configure monitor input, keyboard and mouse destinations across the group. Shared setup changes and computer removals are synchronized to trusted Macs. - **Guided computer setup now adapts to an existing setup.** Add one Mac at a time, keep current computer settings intact, and review the full computer list before saving. Input and Logitech Easy-Switch assignments already in use are protected. - **Existing test installations keep their Mac identity and pairing data** when moving to the stable app identifier. - **Edit an existing computer setup without restarting the add flow.** - **Pairing guidance for unpaired destinations** and availability warnings that explain when a Mac cannot be checked directly. - **OpenSwitch menu surface refinements** and clearer About/update messaging for development builds.
### Release candidate - This prerelease adds the OpenSwitch-owned Sparkle update feed. Install this build once manually; builds before it do not have an update feed configured.
